meta.title: Artistica: printable reference sheets for artists
meta.description: Turn reference photos into print-ready sheets. Pack photos onto A4 or Letter pages, add crop marks and bleed, and export a PDF. Free, private, in your browser.

share.title: Artistica: printable reference sheets for artists
share.description: Drop in your photos and get print-ready sheets with crop marks and bleed. Free, private, in your browser.
share.imageAlt: Artistica: reference photos packed onto printable sheets

structured.description: Turn reference photos into print-ready sheets with crop marks and bleed. Runs entirely in your browser.
structured.browserRequirements: Requires JavaScript. Latest Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.

hero.title: Turn reference photos into print-ready sheets.
hero.lead: Drop in your photos. Artistica packs them onto pages at a good drawing size and adds crop marks and bleed. Then print, cut and draw.
hero.points: Photos never leave your device · Free · No sign-up

add.title: Add photos
add.body: Upload, drag in, paste, or use a link. JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF and iPhone HEIC.

paper.title: Pick your paper
paper.body: A4, Letter and more. Artistica finds a layout with the fewest pages and the biggest images.

print.title: Print & cut
print.body: Download a PDF with crop marks and optional bleed. Print at 100% and cut along the marks.

features.title: Made to help you see

packing.title: Smart packing
packing.body: Sizes each photo for drawing, never past what its pixels allow at 300 DPI.

marks.title: Crop marks and bleed
marks.body: Printer-style marks, optional bleed, and a safe area, so cutting is easy.

edit.title: Edit each photo
edit.body: Crop, rotate, flip, print copies, or fix an exact size.

phone.title: Works on your phone
phone.body: A step-by-step flow on small screens, side panels on desktop, light and dark.

features.next: blur and value studies, composition lines.

claims.1: Everything runs in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
claims.2: Photos are never saved. Refreshing the page clears them.
claims.3: Only your settings are remembered, on this device.

size.q: Will my prints be the right size?
size.a: Yes, if you print at 100% (“Actual size”). Pages are made at the exact paper size you pick.

link.q: Why won't an image link work?
link.a: Some sites block other apps from reading their images. Download the image and upload it instead.

bleed.a: Crop marks show where to cut. Bleed prints a little extra past the cut, so a slightly-off cut leaves no white edge.

uploaded.a: No. Everything runs in your browser. Photos are never uploaded or saved, and refreshing the page clears them.

guides.q: What finds the face and pose guides?
guides.a: Face and pose guides use Google's MediaPipe models, running on your device.

phone.q: Does it work on my phone?
phone.a: Yes: latest Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari on desktop, iPhone and Android.
